title: WRS Affix Review Cards (prefixes + suffixes)
sourceNote: Prefix and suffix elements, example words, prefix meanings, and first-taught substeps come from the Fourth Edition Student Notebook Answer Keys (Steps 7-12, printed pp. 33-36, 38-39) and Instructor Manual. Suffix meanings are accepted standard definitions where Wilson gives none. Some example words (and the meanings of hypo-, hyper-, and anti-) were chosen by the teacher to be more familiar and fitting for students; cards flagged TEACHER_CHOSEN_EXAMPLE or TEACHER_CHOSEN_MEANING differ from the printed Notebook row. All affix illustrations are teacher-created, not Wilson art.
